text:
sam: Heads-up — cutoff in ~2h for v0.22. Quick rollcall on a few items: version bump merged? changelog scrubbed? security ok? smoke passed? branch sync? pinging owners @maggie @rahul @jen
maggie: Version bump PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234 — awaiting one review, tiny package.json change.
rahul: Reviewing now. small, looks like a patch bump — will confirm semver intent.
maggie: Confirmed: patch (0.21.9 -> 0.21.10). no API changes.
jen: Docs scrub done; added example for the new config toggle and notes about rollout.
tom: QA smoke tests queued (job #9876). Running against staging.
qa-bot: Smoke tests started: https://ci.redwood.com/jobs/9876
qa-bot: Smoke tests passed on staging — all critical flows green.
security: Dependency scanner flagged openssl 1.1.x advisory. Low severity; patch available. Recommend backport.
sam: Can we get a quick backport + changelog bullet for that? @security @maggie
security: ACK. Low risk. Backport + changelog note recommended.
maggie: Opening backport PR to release/v0.22: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1235
olivia: Changelog updated with backport note, runtime fix, and docs pointer. Preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/compare/release/v0.22
rahul: Reviewed version bump and backport — LGTM.
tom: QA verified backport on release candidate — no regressions observed.
sam: Last call for blockers — planning to cut branch in 30m unless anyone objects.
jen: Docs link: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/v0.22 — updated the config toggle section.
maggie: Merged backport into release/v0.22 and pushed the candidate tag.
sam: Cutting branch now: `git checkout release/v0.22 && git merge --no-ff main -m "cut v0.22-rc1" && git push origin release/v0.22` — tagging v0.22-rc1
deploy-bot: Release branch created: release/v0.22 at commit abcdef123 (v0.22-rc1). CI matrix started.
sam: Thanks all — will monitor CI and staging smoke. :tada:
olivia: I'll follow up with release notes email and docs sync after CI green.
security: Confirming monitoring hooks are in place for the rollout.
rahul: If anything pops up I'll open a hotfix PR.
sam: Closing this thread — keeping ears open. :lock_with_ink_pen:
